reviewContext.issueReference: comm-000001: Implement Work Runtime P1-6d bounded agent-director child and judged-work acceptance
reviewContext.userProblem: Retained P1-6d validator refuses accept and CLI rejects director entry; judged-work linkage, ordinary child execution and exact accounting remain unimplemented.
requiredOutcomes: One bounded optional director child through the ordinary runner and shared store with durable judged-work linkage and exact child session, attempt and cost accounting.
Shared causal, version, completion, human-accept and budget validation governs allowed child decisions; invalid, failed, forbidden or budget-blocked child paths durably escalate.
Forward the existing finite host capability snapshot to planner inputs and verify selected backend and host delivery.
Run source-matched focused and broad checks, independent test-integrity, single adversarial and Astra combined-tree review; update exact progress/docs and publish only after acceptance.
nonGoals: No P1-7b task-backed replacement bundles, P1-7a legacy removal, parent P1 closure or unrelated broad failure repair.
No recursive director, second task store, replacement planner or host-discovery architecture, main merge or Monja changes.
constraints: Preserve P1-6a/b/c commits and user work on feat/remaining-impl-plans; one serial owner for coupled store/model/CLI edits, independent read-only review.
Reconcile judged work before child reservation; durable linkage and once-only accounting remain authoritative after reopen and replay.
Keep all scratch and complete foreground verification logs under repository tmp/; no force push or broad staging.
The prior 2059-test aggregate failed with 19 classified non-slice assertions and cannot certify this slice.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Atomically reserve the .director child and persist task, judged attempt, child attempt and exact session identities so replay and shared application can verify authority.
Use the existing shared applier to reconstruct accept from durable judged-work gates, verification, acceptance and findings; child success alone cannot prove work success.
Deliver judged TaskView and hostCapabilityContext through ordinary workflow variables while preserving selected placement and other inputs.
intentionalTradeoffs: One serial plan owns coupled store/model/CLI and tests; shared parent P1 documentation is reconciled after behavior and reviews.
Only one optional child round per judged attempt; failed or uncertain child paths require escalation and human action rather than recursive repair.
supportedEdgeCases: Valid allowed accept; missing gates or blocking findings; requiresHumanAccept; stale version; newer work; missing, foreign or stale linkage; wrong child session.
Failed, malformed, forbidden and budget-blocked child; successful last-admitted work; no recursive child.
Fresh and reopened store, transaction rollback, repeated dispatch, terminal reconciliation and decision replay with unchanged judged evidence and exact once-only accounting.
Actual child node receives judged TaskView and hostCapabilityContext; selected backend/host delivery and dry-run/P1-6a/c compatibility.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: P1-7b replacement examples and P1-7a before-removal legacy deletion.
Unrelated baseline failures and later parent P1 completion.
sourcePaths: impl-plans/active/work-runtime-p1-dispatcher-guard-director.md — Current executable contract and P1-6d judged-work acceptance and child execution
reviewContext.reviewDecision: Step 3 accepted the §17.8 design without findings; Step 5 accepted the single P1-6d plan at comm-000008 without findings. Implementation and later review gates remain open.

Fresh/reopened-store, rollback and replay tests prove exact child task/session/attempt/cost accounting once and unchanged judged-work evidence.
Actual child node receives original judged TaskView and hostCapabilityContext; selected backend/host and dry-run/P1-6a/c behavior remain correct.

Source-matched build, positive-count focused suites, V1-V4/V11 as affected, strict touched-file SwiftLint, diff checks and serial broad gate have complete logs, hashes, counts, exits and explicit non-slice failure classification.
